## What type of PR is this? (check all applicable)

- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Feature
- [X] Bug Fix
- [ ] Optimization
- [ ] Documentation Update

## Description

Both the "Add a cover image" and "Upload image" inputs in the article editor had some accessibility issues, and as a result we also had to skip some rules in our frontend tests. 

This PR refactors the markup to keep the same functionality but making sure that we don't nest the input inside of a `button` element. We do however want the `button` element when a user is using a native iOS device, in which case we don't show the 'normal' desktop input but instead surface a button with enhanced native functionality.

I don't have an iOS device, but I tested this out on the simulator and all seemed to be working well. Definitely keen for someone who has a real device to test this PR too 😄 

## Related Tickets & Documents

Fixes #13947

## QA Instructions, Screenshots, Recordings

- Log in and click 'Create post'
- Add a cover image, and check it works as expected
- Try changing the cover image and removing it to make sure all functionality as before
- Repeat the process for the general 'Upload image' option in both the V1 and V2 editors
- Check how the UI looks in a few browsers... _just in case_
- Try activating the upload buttons by tabbing to them and pressing Enter - it should all work as expected

### UI accessibility concerns?

This fixes the accessibility issue where an interactive control (the file input) was nested inside of a button. Although in brief testing things seemed to be working OK (at least with VoiceOver in Safari), it's likely this would have caused issues for some users on some devices.

It also makes sure the accessible name of the file upload button is clear and concise changing it from "Upload image Upload image Upload an image button" to "Upload image". It's now also accurately announced as a file upload button.
